suggested_snapshot_fields_to_add.why: Makes mover/fast-mover landing hexes explicit so the planner can deterministically target likely end cells.
Precomputes whether an option’s end/target/ray/AoE/intercept cells cover enemy reachable landing cells, reducing guesswork and helping exact landing-cell commits.
Lets the planner immediately detect exact reach/contact options instead of choosing adjacent pressure cells.
